issuesEn: Three grey placeholder cards under a placeholder top bar; nothing on screen was readable
Flat front-on view: a 28px lift read as a scale-up, and the elliptical shadow was a grey haze that never sold leaving the table
All three call-outs had identical timing and no hierarchy; every card dropped back so the ending had no hero
Dead flat light-grey stage with the cards in a thin middle band
changesEn: Porcelain look (cool white + cobalt): three 420×600 portrait weekly-focus cards, Meetings 6h / Recharge 4h / Deep work 18h, with 160px numerals, 32px notes and a weekday strip under a 120px headline "Shape your week."

A 2.5D high-angle desk (rotateX 24°→20° with a perspective dot grid): cards lift 96px along the desk normal while two independent shadow layers lying on the desk (contact core + ambient) grow, soften, fade and drift away from the light
Rhythm is scan, scan, pick: two brisk call-outs (10f up / 14f hover / 8f down + 2f settle), then the third rises on a slow spring (damping 16) and stays airborne as the single hero
Selection follow-through: cobalt outline, a spring-popped check that draws on, weekday cells turn cobalt; the other cards dim while one is lifted
The camera trails the called card by ±40px and pushes in 2.5% after the pick
